requirements.text: A petri  net has a place
a petri net model has nets
A petri net model has arcs
In a Petri net, there are places and nets. Each place must be associated to exactly one net
A petri net has places and TPArcs, each place can be part of zero or more arcs
In a petri net model, a transition must be always part of exactly one net
A transition has one to many outgoing TPArcs
A Net is composed of one to many Places
